title: Address govspend Greptile review feedback
reason: Greptile review identified that agency dry-run resolved agencies with a live USAspending call, SAM.gov query-key placement needed documented rationale, and root.go retained an unused strings placeholder.
validated_outcome: Agency dry-run now returns the USAspending request payload without fetching agency references, SAM.gov api_key query placement is documented as matching the public Opportunities API v2 contract, and the unused strings placeholder was removed. A focused regression test verifies agency dry-run does not call the network.
